## Download

Pick the one for your machine:

- **Windows** — [LogIT-{{VERSION}}-Windows-Installer.exe](https://github.com/amytis25/LogIT-logging-app/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/LogIT-{{VERSION}}-Windows-Installer.exe)
  Installs it like a normal program and adds a Start-menu entry. **Most people want this one.**
- **Windows, without installing** — [LogIT-{{VERSION}}-Windows-Portable.exe](https://github.com/amytis25/LogIT-logging-app/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/LogIT-{{VERSION}}-Windows-Portable.exe)
  A single file that runs straight from your Downloads folder or a USB stick. Nothing is
  installed and nothing is left behind when you delete it. Use this one on a lab machine, or
  if you'd rather try it before letting it install.
- **macOS** — [LogIT-{{VERSION}}-macOS.dmg](https://github.com/amytis25/LogIT-logging-app/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/LogIT-{{VERSION}}-macOS.dmg)
  Works on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Open it and drag LogIT to Applications.
- **Linux** — [LogIT-{{VERSION}}-Linux.AppImage](https://github.com/amytis25/LogIT-logging-app/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/LogIT-{{VERSION}}-Linux.AppImage)
  Make it executable (`chmod +x`) and run it. No install, no package manager.

> **Your computer will warn you the first time.** The app isn't code-signed — certificates
> cost a few hundred dollars a year and this is free. On Windows, click
> **More info → Run anyway**. On macOS, right-click the app → **Open** → **Open**.
> You only do it once.

## What this has actually been tested on

- 🟢 **Windows 11** — what I build on and use all day, every day. If something is solid
  anywhere, it's here.
- 🔴 **macOS** — builds. Nobody has launched it yet. Expect rough edges, especially around the
  floating button and window behaviour. Tell me how it goes and this line gets upgraded.
- 🔴 **Linux** — builds. Nobody has ever launched it. You would be the first, and I'd
  genuinely like to hear how it goes.

## What's new

- macOS and Linux builds, for the first time.

## Found a bug?

[Open an issue](https://github.com/amytis25/LogIT-logging-app/issues/new) — tell me your OS,
what you were doing, what you expected, and what happened instead. Screenshots help.

This is a side project I'm sharing because it's useful to me, not a supported product. I fix
things when I get to them, and the code is all here if you'd rather fix it yourself.
